triage_rules: Every candidate must receive a file-format-relevant, runtime-only, diagnostic-only, or unknown disposition with an exact source-backed reason.
Runtime-only functions still require documented boundaries when their behavior affects provider selection, redirects, package identity or error signaling.
New evidence cannot be certified from source symbol presence alone; retain a positive/negative test and pinned implementation fingerprint.
Do not silently discard compiler-conditional or version-conditional branches.
limitations: This is a triage plan, not completed per-candidate classification.
The B017 expression scans only four qualified UE5 classes and can miss virtual, inline, macro, or serializer dispatch.
